description: A voltage folder built on modulo arithmetic, after the CGS Modulo Magic. Each time the incoming voltage crosses a threshold, a fixed step is added to it or taken off it, for a set number of steps

params.text: Chooses whether the voltage arriving at the initiation input is added to the threshold or taken off it
Sets the threshold the input is compared against; each crossing applies one step
Chooses whether the voltage arriving at the offset input is added to the offset or taken off it
Added to the threshold for the first step only, which moves where in the incoming shape the folding starts
Attenuates the voltage arriving at the VC ADD input
Attenuates the voltage arriving at the VC SUB input
Sets the voltage added or taken off at each crossing of the threshold
How many crossings apply a step, 1 to 8; after that the output follows the input with the steps so far kept as a fixed offset

inputs.text: A voltage moving the initiation threshold
A voltage added to the step size
A voltage taken off the step size

outputs.text: The input after the steps have been added or taken off
